decision_rules.blocked_reproducibility: A scientifically benchmarkable task is present, but executable access, installation, licensing, dependencies, or stable invocation prevents a reproducible benchmark.
decision_rules.contextual_comparator_only: Scientifically relevant direct/near-direct comparator, but quantitative head-to-head comparison would be invalid, task-mismatched, or dependent on fundamentally different character types or assumptions.
decision_rules.endpoint_specific_benchmark_candidate: Method can be benchmarked quantitatively for one or more overlapping endpoints, but not as a whole-tool substitute for BRANCHSNV.
decision_rules.quantitative_benchmark_candidate: Requires reproducible executable access, sufficiently documented inputs and outputs, and output semantics that can be mapped fairly to the same pre-specified BRANCHSNV endpoint(s).
decision_rules.unresolved: Evidence is insufficient for a terminal feasibility class; uncertainty must remain explicit rather than being converted to exclusion.

preferred_order: official software repository or release archive
archived project page or package registry

fairness_rules: Do not require every direct/near-direct comparator to be executed.
Do not classify a method as unsuitable merely because it is old, slow, unpopular, or inconvenient.
Do not compare outputs that answer materially different scientific questions under a single accuracy metric.
Where only one BRANCHSNV endpoint overlaps, restrict any quantitative comparison to that endpoint.
Do not silently substitute successor software, forks, wrappers, or reimplementations for the frozen method family; document any such mapping explicitly.
Do not treat generic phylogenetic tree inference accuracy as a BRANCHSNV benchmark endpoint.
Do not use publication citation count, repository popularity, or recency as feasibility criteria.
No failed installation or unavailable URL alone changes scientific comparator status; it changes benchmark feasibility only.

frozen_branchsnv_endpoints.description: Discovery of nucleotide sites/markers associated with a defined clade or lineage, including strict clade-exclusive site behaviour where supported by the comparator.
Inference or reporting of state/substitution changes associated with a specified phylogenetic branch, focal edge, ancestor-to-descendant transition, or equivalent lineage transition.
Detection or interpretation of homoplasy, convergence, parallel change, recurrence, reversal, or repeated character-state change.
Deployment of discovered markers or phylogenetic states for lineage/clade assignment or genotyping.

next_gate_note: After this design is frozen, separately authorize source-backed feasibility assessment of all 29 method families. That assessment may research software availability and documentation but must not install or execute comparator software unless a later execution authorization explicitly permits it.

scientific_scope.purpose: Determine which of the 29 frozen direct/near-direct method families can support a fair, reproducible quantitative benchmark against one or more BRANCHSNV analytical endpoints, and which should remain contextual comparators.
